latest_issue_label: The World at Work (22nd print issue, special photography edition)
independence_evidence: Co-founded and run by its editor-in-chief/CEO and publisher from Austin, Texas (P.O. Box 15007, Austin, TX 78761), funded by subscriptions and donations (https://strangersguide.com/masthead/); no media-group ownership.
qualifies_reason: Independent Austin travel-writing title whose 22nd print guide, The World at Work, was published in May 2026.
what_it_is: A book-like print 'guide' series in which each issue is devoted to one place or theme and gathers long-form reporting, essays, fiction and photography, mostly by writers from that place. The latest edition is a photography-led issue on work and labour around the world. It is for readers who want literary, place-based journalism rather than conventional travel tips.

cover_candidates.notes: Flat front cover from the publisher's issue page; checked visually.

uncertainties: Issue date is inferred from the issue page's May 2026 upload paths and the distributor hint (print issue May 2026); no day given. Frequency: issue pages date Chicago to mid-2023, Around the World to early 2024, Complicating Colonialism to mid-2024 and The World at Work to May 2026, so output has been irregular (about one to two a year with a gap in 2025). The masthead does not name a legal entity beyond 'Stranger's Guide'.
